facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of the traditional Recoleta neighborhood, steps from the Santa Fe Avenue shopping area.
facts.excerpt: Located in the heart of the traditional Recoleta neighborhood, just steps from Santa Fe Ave. shopping area.

facts.text: Before it became the Palladio, the property was a private palace and later the birthplace of local politician Nicolas Rodriguez Pena.
facts.excerpt: Before it was the Palladio, the property was a private palace, and later the birthplace of local politician Nicolás Rodríguez Peña.

facts.text: Rooms have large double-glazed windows that bring in plenty of light.
facts.excerpt: All rooms stand out for its superb luminosity and large double glazed windows

facts.text: Room bathrooms are covered in marble, with a double sink and a separate shower.
facts.excerpt: The luxurious bathrooms covered in marble have double sink and separate shower.

facts.text: The Palladio Executive Suite is on the 14th floor, with living and dining spaces, a marble bathroom with a hydromassage tub, and a kitchenette.
facts.excerpt: with living and dining spaces, 55 inch LCD TV, splendid marbled bathroom with hydromassage bathtub, separate shower, toilet and kitchenette.

facts.text: The Palladio Executive Suite is located on the 14th floor with a view.
facts.excerpt: Unique and exclusive suite located on the 14th floor with a fantastic view.

facts.text: The hotel has a Spa and Wellness Center and a heated outdoor pool.
facts.excerpt: Relax and recover energy with a treatment at your choice in our exclusive Spa & Wellness Center and soak up the sun at the heated outdoor pool.

facts.text: The heated outdoor pool is on the rooftop and overlooks the neighborhood.
facts.excerpt: The heated outdoor rooftop pool is a real asset; it’s small but well-maintained, with enough space to actually swim laps while overlooking the views across the neighborhood.

facts.text: Spa facials use Germaine de Capuccini professional cosmetics.
facts.excerpt: Our facials treatments use Germaine de Capuccini Advanced Professional Cosmetics line.

facts.text: The hotel has a modern gym.
facts.excerpt: enjoy a ﬁtness routine in our modern gym equipped with last generation devices.

facts.text: Negresco Bistro serves Mediterranean cuisine with a seasonal menu and a list of local wines.
facts.excerpt: NEGRESCO BISTRÓ serves Mediterranean cuisine in a modern atmosphere and will delights customers with its seasonal menu and an exceptional list of local wines.

facts.text: La Terrazza serves cocktails, champagne and snacks with sunset views from the 11th floor.
facts.excerpt: Sip a delicious cocktail or a glass of champagne, and indulge with a selection of delicious snacks while enjoying the unforgettable sunsets from the 11th floor.

facts.text: The hotel offers connecting rooms and a rooftop pool, which make it family-friendly.
facts.excerpt: With 20 connecting rooms and a rooftop pool, this property feels family-friendly without sacrificing its overall elegance.

facts.text: The hotel is a two-minute walk from the Callao metro station.
facts.excerpt: You're a two-minute walk from the Callao metro station, making the rest of the city easily accessible.

facts.text: Recoleta Cemetery is nearby, as are museums, bookshops and the Sunday flea market.
facts.excerpt: Recoleta Cemetery is nearby, as are museums, bookshops, and the Sunday flea market.

facts.text: The hotel has a solar-paneled rooftop terrace and a vertical garden of native species at the rear of the building.
facts.excerpt: a solar-paneled rooftop terrace, a vertical garden blooming with native species at the building's rear

facts.text: All rooms have 24-hour room service, complimentary wifi, a minibar and a tea and espresso machine.
facts.excerpt: All rooms feature complimentary WIFI, minibar, tea & expresso machine, In-room safe suitable for a laptop, desk and 24-hour room service.

facts.text: The hotel is part of Accor's MGallery Collection.
facts.excerpt: Part of Accor's MGallery Collection, the brand is known for boutique hotels with individual character rather than cookie-cutter design.

facts.text: The rooftop pool is small.
facts.excerpt: The heated outdoor rooftop pool is a real asset; it’s small but well-maintained

facts.text: The hotel is closer to the bustle of Avenida Santa Fe than to Recoleta's quieter residential pockets.
facts.excerpt: The property is in Recoleta, but closer to the hustle of Avenida Santa Fe than any quieter residential pockets.
